---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - conda-forge::python=3.10.0
  - r-base=4.4
  - r-caret=7.0_1
  - r-e1071=1.7_17
  - r-optparse=1.8.2
  - pip:
      - fungtion==1.0.0

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process FUNGTION_DOWNLOADMODELS {
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/40/401a8c91682bec5f7030ed167ab55986d9255b7ebde4b9b06ab6e5b1f447bd50/data':
        'community.wave.seqera.io/library/r-base_r-e1071_r-caret_r-optparse_pruned:c4d8b270ddf00cb9' }"

    output:
    path("models")                                                                            , emit: models
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('fungtion'), eval("fungtion --version 2>&1 | head -1"), topic: versions, emit: versions_fungtion
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('python'), eval("python --version | sed 's/Python //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_python

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    """
    fungtion setup-models --model-dir models
    """

    stub:
    """
    mkdir -p models
    touch models/esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S.pt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/fungtion/downloadmodels"
description: "Downloads the pretrained ESM-1b weights (esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S.pt) that\
  \ fungtion\nuses for fungal effector prediction into a local models/ directory via\n\
  `fungtion setup-models`. The downloaded directory is used as input to the\nFUNGTION_FUNGTION\
  \ prediction module.\n"
keywords:
- "fungal"
- "effector"
- "protein"
- "prediction"
- "language model"
- "deep learning"
- "model"
- "download"
tools:
- fungtion:
    description: "Fungtion predicts and visualizes fungal effector proteins from protein\
      \ FASTA\nsequences using ESM-1b protein language model embeddings and R-based\
      \ SVM models.\nFor predicted effectors it can generate similarity-network and\
      \ relationship-tree\nvisualizations and an HTML report.\n"
    homepage: "https://github.com/noHup-cc/fungtion"
    documentation: "https://github.com/noHup-cc/fungtion"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/noHup-cc/fungtion"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:fungtion"
input: []
output:
  models:
  - models:
      type: "directory"
      description: "Directory containing the pretrained ESM-1b weights (esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S.pt)\n\
        downloaded by `fungtion setup-models`. This directory is passed as the\n`pretrain`\
        \ input to FUNGTION_FUNGTION.\n"
      pattern: "models"
      ontologies: []
  versions_fungtion:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fungtion:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - fungtion --version 2>&1 | head -1:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_python:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - python:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python --version | sed 's/Python //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fungtion:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - fungtion --version 2>&1 | head -1:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - python:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python --version | sed 's/Python //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@vagkaratzas"
maintainers:
- "@vagkaratzas"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
